status: secondary structurally-evaluable subset frozen before any fine-place-conditioned vertical outcome
role: post-freeze exploratory mechanism test; not a rescue of the failed five-panel preflight and cannot modify v0.3.8 submission claims

origin.selection_basis: x-y-time-only structural support; no fine-place-conditioned vertical outcome was opened

excluded_panel.reason: 2/14 evaluable at 500 m, 1 km and 2 km; failed predeclared five-panel support gate

origin.grid_selection_reason: 2 km is the coarsest predeclared fine-place candidate and retained >=70% plus >=5 individuals in every included panel; it maximizes structural support without reopening a new grid search

ecological_hypotheses.fine_route_allocation: Residual vertical individuality after coarse 5-km and broad kinematic-state conditioning is largely generated by individuals using different fine horizontal routes/patches within those coarse strata.
ecological_hypotheses.within_fine_context: Individual centered vertical organization remains non-exchangeable even after self and other profiles are evaluated under identical 2-km fine-place × speed × turning-state distributions.

state_definition.thresholding: cohort medians estimated from valid x-y-time endpoints

estimator.vertical_centering: subtract each retained session's median primary vertical coordinate computed from all retained numeric-height events
estimator.conditional_profile: P(centered residual height | 2-km fine cell, speed×turn state)
estimator.common_weighting: For fine-cell × kinematic-state strata supported by both self and other predictors, compute equal-session self training weights and apply the identical stratum weights to both vertical profiles.
estimator.target_scoring: score target kinematic endpoints whose fine-cell × state stratum is supported by both predictors

calibration.permutation_unit: whole centered session block with fixed x-y-time-derived kinematic states
calibration.preserve: all within-session fine-place-state-residual-z observations and exact session-count multiset per label
calibration.panel_pass_rule: exact expected evaluable n; observed-minus-null-mean common fine-place-state identity > 0; one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

synthesis.primary_statistic: number of the four structurally evaluable panels passing

decision_matrix.3_or_4_pass: Within the structurally evaluable subset, 2-km route/patch allocation is insufficient as a general explanation; vertical individuality persists within fine-place × kinematic contexts.
decision_matrix.1_or_2_pass: Mixed mechanism: fine-place allocation may explain substantial variation in some systems while within-context individuality remains in others.
decision_matrix.0_pass: Consistent with 2-km fine-place allocation accounting for most of the residual in the structurally evaluable subset, subject to support and power.

synthesis.generalization_limit: No inference to Eidolon and no five-panel general claim from this subset.

claim_boundary: The four-panel subset is determined only by a pre-outcome structural preflight; this is not post-outcome panel deletion.
A PASS means persistence within 2-km fine-place × speed×turn matching, not exact route/resource matching below 2 km.
Fine cells are matching strata, not verified feeding patches or routes.
Persistence does not prove morphology, memory, learning, personality or causal intrinsic phenotype.
This result cannot replace or rescue the failed five-panel fine-place preflight and remains outside v0.3.8.
stop_rule: Do not change the 2-km grid, speed2_turn2 definition, centering, vertical bins, 50-event support, expected n, permutation counts/seeds or pass rules after output is opened.
Do not add Eidolon or change the four-panel subset after vertical output.
Do not substitute 1-km or 500-m sensitivities if the 2-km primary fails.
